claims: Dusty May is the head coach of the University of Michigan men's basketball team.
Dusty May was hired in March 2024 to replace Juwan Howard.
Dusty May was the head coach at Florida Atlantic University from 2018 to 2024.
Dusty May led Florida Atlantic University to the 2023 Final Four.
Dusty May is the David and Meredith Kaplan Men's Basketball Head Coach.
Dusty May is guiding the University of Michigan Wolverines for the 2025-26 season.
Kim Barnes Arico is the head coach of the Michigan Wolverines women’s basketball team.
Kim Barnes Arico has held the position since 2012.
Kim Barnes Arico is the winningest coach in Michigan Wolverines women’s basketball program history
